description: The first-run checklist (Shopify's setup guide): steps with their state and the control that performs each, a counted progress line, and a dismiss that appears only when the work is done. Lives at the top of a product's home until it has earned its removal. Copy: every step starts with a verb and describes one action — "Connect a calendar". The detail says why it is worth doing, not how the control works.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Dismiss, shown ONLY when every step is done. A dismissed guide never returns (the caller persists that), so first-run and steady-state are one page with a section that retires itself.
